verdict.rationale: Docs confirm New Relic alerting can evaluate signals for 'abnormal behavior' in addition to fixed thresholds (new-relic-docs-33), implying baseline/anomaly detection capability, but the evidence pack gives no deeper explanation of how anomaly/baseline alerts are configured, no independent validation, and most alerting docs emphasize manual thresholds (new-relic-docs-5, new-relic-docs-25). Missing for 10: detailed docs on baseline anomaly alert setup, ML-based outlier detection specifics, and hands-on/independent confirmation it surfaces problems without manual tuning.
